PluginData.Author: OwendB
PluginData.Tooltip: Server-side anti-cheat guards and admin audit logging
PluginData.Description:
Anti-Cheat is a Magnetar server plugin for Space Engineers dedicated servers. It adds configurable server-side enforcement around malformed client RPCs, validation failures, oversized payloads, and admin creative-tool activity.
Current protections include toolbar request validation, camera-setting bounds, GPS and faction payload length caps, social-list and known-sector overflow guards, and escalation for repeated validation failures.
The admin audit module logs creative tools toggles, creative/admin block placement, and creative-mode welding activity so staff actions leave a clear server-side trail.
